cases.input: Build a Todo product without specifying user, persistence or scope.
cases.expected: Separate assumptions and consequential unknowns; no unsupported user research or premature build.

cases.input: Change a button label in an existing accepted product.
cases.expected: Use the relevant narrow contract, no full product redesign or unrelated infrastructure.

cases.input: UI acceptance is required but the runtime has no browser tool.
cases.expected: Record a capability gap and request real observations; no invented screenshots or passed acceptance.

cases.input: An approved check exits nonzero although the worker says complete.
cases.expected: Block acceptance and retain actual log, source fingerprint and failure.
Invalidate affected work, preserve old evidence, create new revision and review.

cases.input: A worker process terminates after changing source but before a result.
cases.expected: Recover as blocked, inspect actual changes, never silently declare done or replay an external action.

cases.input: A reviewer identifies a repeated context omission.
cases.expected: Link evidence and propose a reproducible eval case; do not automatically edit the active skill.
